community_list_entries.name: Seeing, Listening, Remembering, and Reasoning: A Multimodal Agent with Long-Term Memory

phase1_classification.kind_reason: The paper contributes both M3-Agent and M3-Bench, a long-video QA benchmark (100 robot-perspective and 920 web videos) built to evaluate memory-based reasoning in multimodal agents. The data is on HF (ByteDance-Seed/M3-Bench).
